apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- GS: keep shader caches in RAM, one pack per game, written in the background
- tests: compare a VU pack's age as an integer, which gtest can print on macOS
- microVU: keep the VU program cache in RAM, one pack file per game
- microVU: keep one program cache per options sentinel
- COP2 macro: bound every product's multiplicands from vuClampMode 2
- GS/Vulkan: describe the pre-rotation switch as troubleshooting, not the sideways fix
- GS: size the shader chain, Bilinear (Sharp) and CAS against the presentation size
- GS/Vulkan: the Lottes CRT filter scales to the target rect's own size
- GS/Vulkan: present filters take the window position from v_tex
- GS/Vulkan: name the Android window system in the swap chain log line
- Android: offer the swap chain pre-rotation switch in Fixes
- GS/Vulkan: say in the swap chain log line when pre-rotation is off by setting
- GS/Vulkan: a setting to leave the screen's rotation to the compositor
- Controls: a trigger resting a little above zero no longer holds L2/R2
- DriverPacks: recognise Adreno when the DRM device is on msm_dpu
- Discord: the status line shows the game's title instead of ARMSX2
- Controls: a serial-less game's own controller mapping applies in game
- Android: translate the IOP thread, VU1 compiler, auto-tune and GPU driver setup strings
- UI: selection highlights only show while a controller is driving
- Android: the in-game menu reopens where it was left
- Textures: fetch catalog.json, the one texture-pack metadata file
- Textures: read one file, the catalog, for the packs and who made them
- Qt/Wayland: pre-rotate for the screen's rotation, read from Qt
- GS/Vulkan: prefer an 8-bit sRGB swap chain format
- GS/Vulkan: pre-rotate the swap chain when the surface reports a rotation
- GS/Vulkan: turn the ImGui overlay the same way as the game image
- Android: offer and recommend ARMSX2 Turnip on the Adreno A12 (613)
- GS: recognise the Adreno 613 under its "Adreno A12" name
- GS/Vulkan: keep a draw's textures across a mid-draw submit and restart
- GS/Vulkan: drop the Volumetric renderer from the restart load-op comment
- Android: getGameSerialFromFd's comment now says gzip images are read
- Android: accept a wrapped folder-card zip with stray top-level files
- Android: don't make the UI thread wait on an achievements server change
- Android: drop the limiter reset from the VM shutdown handler
- Give each library category picker row its own controller id
- Fix missing serial and cover for gzip games in the library
- Fix library XMB wave shader failing to compile on Mali
- Reset every Performance setting from the Performance tab
- Show the right empty-library message when folders are configured
- Send keyboard keys to the search field when the system keyboard is on
- Open the Achievements tab from the Open Achievements hotkey
- Edit the running game's mapping from the in-game Controller Mapping
- Load backup save states from their own file in the Save Manager
- Refuse to create a memory card over an existing one
- Run achievements login, logout and server changes on the CPU thread
- Keep save folders when importing a flat folder memory card zip
- Apply live speed changes on the CPU thread
- Resume the VM on the CPU thread after a JNI state operation
- GS: credit ARMSX2 Contributors in the new files' headers
- GS/Vulkan: a restarted render pass loads what it drew
- GS: comb-adaptive deinterlace for movies in frame mode (opt-in)
- GunCon 2: per-port guns driven by the frontend, and the game's Set Param
- ImGui: let the frontend show the OSD messages itself
- CMake: build an out-of-tree frontend through EXTERNAL_FRONTEND_DIR
- GS: map C32 dirty writes by page masks and reuse them across targets
- GS: preserve untouched target data and map physical writes

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261023...e3c7d2102e733c35b1bb34c4cff9223341dc035a
